title: Holographic Banners
summary: This paper is concerned with eternal AdS black holes. The quantum cosmological future and past interior states of the black hole may be placed on an equal footing to the left and right AdS boundary data by considering the on-shell bulk action as a function of the left/right/future/past data: $S[φ^{(0)L},φ^{(0)R},φ^{(0)F},φ^{(0)P}]$. We call this object a holographic banner, and it obeys the Hamilton-Jacobi equation with respect to all four of its arguments.
